title: AFA Singapore Adds Voice Actress Satomi Arai for Re:ZERO Panel
content: Kadokawa announced on Monday that Satomi Arai will attend the AFA Singapore convention as part of a panel for the Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- anime . The panel will take place at the convention on November 28. Arai voices the character Beatrice in the anime.
author: ANN

title: Animate Manila Store to Open Animate Cafe in 2027
content: Animate's new directly-owned store in Manila opened on Friday, and also revealed that it will use the space adjacent to it to open an Animate Cafe sometime in 2027. Aside from offering food and drinks, Animate often uses its Animate Cafe branches to host collaboration cafes for various franchises.
author: ANN

title: Singer May'n Performs in Bengaluru at Japan Habba 2027
content: Japan Habba will take place on January 9 and January 10 at Chamara Vajra Palace Grounds, Bengaluru. May'n performed songs as the Macross Frontier anime's "Galactic Fairy" idol Sheryl Nome.
author: ANN

title: Just Like Mona Lisa TV Anime's 1st Trailer Unveils More Cast & Staff, 2027 Debut
content: The official website for the television anime of Tsumuji Yoshimura 's Just Like Mona Lisa (Seibetsu "Mona Lisa" no Kimi e.) manga presented on Wednesday the anime's first main trailer, main visual, additional cast and staff members, and 2027 premiere.
author: ANN

title: 'Haru to Gen ~70-sai, Hajimete Kosodate~' Short Anime's Teaser Reveals Cast, January 4 Debut
content: The official website for the short-format television anime of Yuka Ōshima 's Haru to Gen ~70-sai, Hajimete Kosodate~ (Haru and Gen: Raising a Child for the First Time at 70) manga unveiled a new teaser promotional video for the anime on Wednesday. The teaser reveals the anime's cast, as well as its January 4 premiere.
author: ANN

title: Just Like Mona Lisa Anime Reveals Main Visual, Trailer, Additional Cast, Ending Theme Song Artist
content: Just Like Mona Lisa anime revealed a main visual along with a teaser trailer featuring the ending theme song and seven additional cast members. Japanese singer imase is performing the ending theme song, which is featured in the latest trailer. Studio SHAFT is animating the series, set to premiere in 2027.
author: Anime Corner

title: 'Seibetsu "Mona Lisa" no Kimi e.' Unveils Additional Cast, Staff, Ending Theme, First Promo, 2027 Debut
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Tsumuji Yoshimura 's Seibetsu "Mona Lisa" no Kimi e. ( Just Like Mona Lisa ) manga unveiled additional cast, staff, a key visual (pictured), the ending theme, and first promotional video on Wednesday. The anime series will premiere in 2027.
author: MyAnimeList

title: ghost – end of night Anime Film Unveils 3 Cast Members
content: The official website for ghost – end of night ( ghost/yoru no hate ), Shingo Natsume and Madhouse 's new theatrical anime project, announced more cast members for the film on Wednesday.
author: ANN

title: 'Ghost: Yoru no Hate' Announces Additional Cast
content: The official website for the Ghost: Yoru no Hate original anime movie announced three additional cast members on Wednesday. The movie is scheduled to open in Japanese theaters on February 11, 2027. The movie was previewed at Sitges Film Festival on October 9 and at Animation Is Film Festival on October 17.
author: MyAnimeList
